title: Delegation wait tools return 404 for a running host-created acceptance evaluator
outcome: A parent that requested an acceptance evaluation either can await that running evaluator through termal_resume_after_delegations / termal_wait_delegations, or receives a typed refusal that names the evaluator fan-in as the supported completion path, never a bare 404 "delegation not found".
acceptance: A session that requested an acceptance evaluation with termal_evaluate_acceptance, and calls termal_resume_after_delegations or termal_wait_delegations with the returned evaluator delegation id while that evaluator is queued or running, receives either a registered wait or a typed refusal stating that the evaluator completes by its fan-in, not a 404 delegation-not-found error.
A test covers that behaviour against a running evaluator delegation.
